articles.summary: Astec Industries, Inc. (NASDAQ: ASTE) (“Astec” or “Company”) today announced the signing of a definitive agreement to acquire CWMF Corporation (“CWMF”). CWMF (https://cwmfcorp.com/) is a manufacturer of portable and stationary asphalt plant equipment and parts with annual revenues of approximately $50 million.
